how.gist: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back without letting your hips or back move.
steps: Kneel on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace gently so your back stays flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back.
Pause, return without the hips tipping, and switch sides.
how.watch: Hips rotating or the low back arching as the leg goes up.
how.easier: Move only the leg, or only the arm, at first.
how.harder: Hold each reach for 5 to 10 seconds.

how.gist: On all fours, slowly arch your back with your belly down and eyes up, then round it up toward the ceiling.
steps: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Breathe in and let your belly drop, chest forward and eyes up (cow).
Breathe out and round your back up to the ceiling, chin toward chest (cat).
One arch and one round is one rep; move slowly through the whole spine.
how.watch: Moving only the low back while the upper back stays still.
how.harder: Move one segment at a time, starting from the tailbone.

how.gist: Lying face down, press your chest up on your hands while your hips stay on the floor, arching the back gently.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight behind you.
Press up slowly, lifting your chest while your hips stay on the floor.
Straighten your arms only as far as is comfortable; ease off if the low back pinches.
Hold and breathe with shoulders down, then lower slowly.
how.watch: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears as you press.
how.easier: Stay on your forearms with elbows under your shoulders (sphinx).
how.harder: Straighten your arms fully while your hips stay down.

how.gist: Lie on your back, arms up and knees over hips, and slowly lower opposite arm and leg while your low back stays flat.
steps: Lie on your back, arms pointing at the ceiling, knees bent 90° over your hips.
Breathe out and press your low back gently into the floor.
Slowly reach one arm overhead as you straighten the opposite leg toward the floor.
Stop just before your back starts to arch, return, and switch sides.
how.watch: Low back arching off the floor as the leg goes down.
how.easier: Keep the knee bent and just tap the heel to the floor.
how.harder: Hold a light dumbbell or plate in the straight arms.

how.gist: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl your hips off the floor to bring your knees toward your chest, then lower slowly.
steps: Lie on your back, arms by your sides or holding a bench behind your head.
Lift your knees over your hips, bent to 90°.
Breathe out and curl your hips up off the floor, knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly, one vertebra at a time.
how.watch: Swinging the legs instead of curling the hips up.
how.easier: Make the curl smaller, or do a Dead bug.
how.harder: Do a Lying leg raise instead.

how.gist: Lie on your back with straight legs just off the floor and kick them up and down in small, quick alternating beats.
steps: Lie on your back, hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your low back down and lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick the legs up and down in small, quick alternating beats.
Keep the low back down the whole time.
how.watch: Low back arching off the floor as the legs tire.
how.easier: Kick with the legs higher, closer to vertical.
how.harder: Lift your shoulders too, as in a hollow hold.

how.gist: Lying on your back, raise your straight legs to vertical and lower them slowly without your back arching.
steps: Lie on your back, hands under your hips or holding a bench behind your head.
Press your low back toward the floor and keep your legs straight.
Raise your legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your low back arches.
how.watch: Low back arching off the floor as the legs come down.
how.easier: Do a Reverse crunch instead, or bend your knees.
how.harder: Do a Hanging leg raise instead.

how.gist: Lying with your knees bent, tilt your pelvis to flatten your low back into the floor, hold a moment, then let it go.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Breathe out and tilt your pelvis back so your low back flattens into the floor.
Hold for a second or two without lifting your hips.
Breathe in and let your pelvis roll back to a small natural arch.
how.watch: Lifting the hips off the floor into a bridge.

how.gist: Lying on your back with straight legs just off the floor, cross them over and under each other side to side.
steps: Lie on your back, hands under your hips, and press your low back toward the floor.
Lift both straight legs a few inches off the floor.
Open the legs a little and cross one over the other.
Open and cross again with the other leg on top, keeping a steady rhythm.
how.watch: Low back arching off the floor.
how.harder: Lift your head and shoulders off the floor too.

how.gist: Sit leaning back on your hands, then pull your knees in to your chest and push your legs back out without your feet touching down.
steps: Sit on the floor or a bench edge, hands behind your hips, leaning back a little.
Lift your feet and stretch your legs out long.
Pull your knees in toward your chest as your chest comes toward them.
Push your legs back out, keeping your feet off the floor.
how.watch: Leaning far back on the hands so the stomach does little.
how.easier: Let your heels touch down between reps.
how.harder: Hold a dumbbell between your feet, or do a V-up.

how.gist: Lying with your legs in tabletop, lower one foot to tap the floor with the knee still bent, lift it back and switch.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent to 90° over your hips.
Breathe out and draw your stomach in so your low back stays still.
Keep the knee bent and lower one foot to tap the floor.
Lift it back to tabletop and tap the other foot.
how.watch: Low back arching off the mat as the foot lowers.
how.easier: Keep one foot on the floor and tap with the other only.
how.harder: Tap both feet together, or do a Dead bug.

how.gist: Sit leaning back with knees bent and turn your chest side to side, bringing the weight beside each hip.
steps: Sit with knees bent and lean back about 45°, back long and straight.
Hold the weight at your chest.
Turn your shoulders to one side, then the other, bringing the weight beside each hip.
Keep your chest up and turn from the ribs, not just the arms.
how.watch: Back rounding while only the arms swing side to side.
how.easier: Keep your heels on the floor and use no weight.
how.harder: Lift your feet off the floor.

how.gist: Lie on your back, low back pressed down, and hold straight arms and legs just off the floor in a shallow banana shape.
steps: Lie on your back and press your low back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders, arms overhead and straight legs a few inches off the floor.
If your low back starts to lift, raise the legs higher.
Hold the shape, breathing short and steady.
how.watch: Low back peeling off the floor.
how.easier: Bend your knees and keep your arms by your sides.

how.gist: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms and toes, ribs down and glutes tight.
steps: Set your forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders, and step your feet back.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach as if about to be poked.
Keep one straight line from head to heels, eyes on the floor.
Breathe steadily and hold until the line starts to sag.
how.watch: Hips sagging toward the floor so the low back arches.
how.easier: Hold it from your knees instead of your toes.
how.harder: Do RKC plank instead, or rest a plate across your upper back.
